docs/adr/0054-...md:74-83 §3(a) 'Corpus replay … exact for anything downstream of the verification payload — thresholds, blocking_enabled flips, impact-model aggregation changes, floor values' + 'Replay cannot model a change that alters what the verifier emits'

findings.finding: The lever 'ship the unshipped 696a AGENT→1-TURN demotion via ADR-0054 replay' rests on two premises the snapshot does not support: (a) no codebase artifact ties 696a to an AGENT→1-TURN exec-tier demotion — the 696a work in-repo is a G7 blocking-threshold/posture calibration (routing flip @0.85 + rubric guidance), not an exec-tier change; and (b) ADR-0054's own §3(a) Known-limit states replay is exact only for changes downstream of the verification payload and 'cannot model a change that alters what the verifier emits', whereas an AGENT→1-TURN demotion removes the reviewer's codebase/tool access and thus changes emitted findings — the very class replay can only bound, not predict.

findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Reconcile the 'ADR-0054 replay' validation path for the AGENT->1-TURN demotion with ADR-0054 3(a)'s limit (replay only bounds verifier-emitting changes) — state that the demotion must be confirmed by 3(b) dogfooding, and treat any replay figure as a blast-radius bound, not a prediction.
evidence: ADR-0054 3(a): 'Replay cannot model a change that alters what the verifier emits ... replay yields a bound, not a prediction ... A change of that kind is then confirmed by (b), not by commissioning a re-review sweep.'
An AGENT->1-TURN demotion changes model tool-use behavior, i.e. verifier-emitted output, not a Pass-3-downstream (threshold/blocking/impact) quantity that replay scores exactly.
findings.finding: The recommended lever names 'ADR-0054 replay' as the validation instrument for the AGENT->1-TURN demotion, but corpus replay cannot model this change — it alters what the verifier emits (whether tool exploration changes the finding), which ADR-0054 3(a) 'Known limit' says replay can only BOUND, not predict, and must be confirmed by 3(b) dogfooding.
findings.location: Plan headline / 'Top levers' — 'ship the unshipped 696a AGENT->1-TURN demotion via ADR-0054 replay (15-30%)'
scenarios: An implementer picks up this lever, runs an ADR-0054 corpus replay, and reports a 'measurement' that ADR-0054 explicitly says is only a bound — presenting a bound as a prediction, which ADR-0054 forbids ('Do not present a bound as a measurement').
